limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
No synthesis or board work performed.
implementation: Eight uninitialized flip-flops shift toward Q[7] on enabled rising edges, with S entering Q[0]; a combinational mux selects Q[{A,B,C}]. Original ports preserved, no reset or added latency.
testbench: Independent per-tap oracle checks initial unknown state, partial fills, all 256 MSB-first loaded patterns, every address, disabled holds, and stability before rising edges and after falling edges. Includes fatal mismatches and bounded timeout.
static_review: One sequential driver with nonblocking assignment, exactly eight stored bits, complete combinational read, no initialization, reset, extra ports, or pipeline.
